enchantments.tooltip: Anthem: When equipped by a character with Bard levels, this item begins to hum an inspiring tune. Your bard songs regenerate slowly over time.
Resonance +141: Passive: +141 Equipment bonus to Sonic Spell Power.
Sonic Lore +21: Passive: Your Sonic spells gain a 21% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Quality Charisma +3: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Charisma.
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
